title: A density function c'·1_Q of an integer multiplicity current forces c' ∈ ℕ (n-plane case of the dimension-reducing argument)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, let S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) be integer multiplicity (IsIntegerMultiplicity S), let Q ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace (Submodule ℝ ℝ^P), and let c' be a real number with c' > 0. If HasMassDensity S y (1_Q(y)·c') holds for every y ∈ ℝ^P (density c' at points of Q and density 0 off Q; 1_Q(y)·c' is Set.indicator Q (fun _ => c') y), then c' = m for some m ∈ ℕ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (c' : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → 0 < c' → (∀ y : Euclid P, HasMassDensity S y (Set.indicator (Q : Set (Euclid P)) (fun _ => c') y)) → ∃ m : ℕ, c' = m
